data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2020 were GBP 131.621m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 7.3m (c.5.6% of opening reserves), driven by adverse movements in certain older underwriting years (notably 2018 and 2017) partially offset by favourable development in earlier years. The managing agent's narrative reports an overall net surplus on prior year reserves of GBP 5.9m (a net release), indicating that reinsurance recoveries and net movements differed from gross movements. Exposures to natural catastrophe scenarios and liability scenarios are highlighted in the risk tables and form part of the drivers of reserve volatility.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2020, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 5.9m on prior year reserves (2019: deficit GBP 1.8m).
Two key themes from 2019 continued throughout 2020 in our segment of the industry; 1) Natural catastrophe loss activity and 2) US Casualty reserve deterioration.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary source for opening reserves is the Technical Provisions table (claims outstanding) on page 27 (gross). Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 37-38) yielding a gross strengthening of ~GBP 7.305m. The managing agent text reports a net surplus on prior years of GBP 5.9m (net of reinsurance) which conflicts with the gross triangle-derived strengthening; this suggests substantial reinsurer recoveries or differences in scope/timing. Gross movement was used per instructions; the net figure is recorded in the verbatim text. Original tables are presented in GBP '000; triangle values were used as printed (thousands).
